name: Meal Appeal

angles.text: Orgrimmar's daily life includes concerns beyond warfare and defense. Thatog worries about feeding children like Migi as they run through the Valley of Strength.
As an orc, you know how parents like Thatog worry when their children neglect meals to play in the streets of Durotar's capital.

faq.answer: Thatog is an orc parent in Orgrimmar whose daily duties keep him from watching Migi, his young son. Worried that Migi skips meals to play with friends, he asks you to collect and deliver the boy's lunch.
Migi spends his days playing with friends in Orgrimmar. Thatog says you can find the children behind Grommash Hold.
Borstan's Firepit is a place to get food in Orgrimmar. Thatog asks you to collect Migi's arranged lunch there and deliver it to him.
Migi gets so caught up playing with friends behind Grommash Hold that he neglects to eat. He often comes home hungry at day's end.
faq.q: Why does Migi forget to eat?

faq.answer: Migi is Thatog's young son. He spends his time playing with friends in Orgrimmar instead of coming home or collecting his prepared meals.
You collect Migi's lunch from Borstan's Firepit and deliver it to him behind Grommash Hold, so he can eat while he plays.
faq.q: What is the objective of Meal Appeal?

sections.body: Thatog's daily duties keep him at his post in Orgrimmar. He has little time to watch Migi, his energetic young son. From morning until dusk, Migi races through the city with his friends. He often ignores his hunger until he comes home famished.
sections.title: A Parent's Duty in Orgrimmar

sections.body: Thatog arranges a hot lunch for Migi at Borstan's Firepit and asks you to carry it. Migi would rather keep playing than stop to eat. So you take the meal to the yard behind Grommash Hold, where Migi and the neighborhood children play.
sections.title: Delivery Behind the Hold

summary: In Orgrimmar, Thatog worries his young son Migi is skipping meals to play. He asks you to fetch lunch from Borstan's Firepit and find Migi behind Grommash Hold.
